free_text: Given the patient has a PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right mid-gland peripheral zone and a rising PSA velocity of 0.68 ng/mL/yr, a repeat biopsy is indicated despite the prior negative result. This decision is supported by the cohort criterion firing the panel protocol, which aligns with the convergence of the PI-RADS 4 finding and the active disease progression indicated by the PSA velocity. The evidence converged clearly to recommend proceeding with a biopsy.
